title: Scatterplot with linear regression
intent: Show the relationship between automobile power and fuel economy together with a least-squares trend line.

ai.create: Create a scatterplot directly from the cars power (hp) and economy (mpg) fields. Plot may use linearRegressionY; TanStack should pass two typed prepared endpoints to lineY.
ai.maintain: Change the selected automobiles while retaining the imported rows, visible least-squares preparation, source field names, and cast-free channels.
